topic: Alaska (Anchorage, Mat-Su, Fairbanks, Juneau) as an overlooked dental-lab market for Integra Dental Design (Bellevue, WA)
summary:
Bottom line: Alaska is small, high-fee, logistically reachable same-day from Seattle, and already served by a handful of credible Anchorage labs plus several in-house labs. It is not "underserved" on the evidence; it is thin outside Anchorage and thin on independent digital/implant milling capacity. Obtainable demand for Integra is modest and skewed toward (a) lab-to-lab milling for small Anchorage labs, (b) digital-only GP offices in Fairbanks, Juneau and Mat-Su that have no local crown-and-bridge lab, and (c) implant-restoring GPs working with the oral-surgeon referral network who lack Take 2's or Woodside's in-house technician.

FACTS (sourced). Dentist supply: the Alaska Board of Dental Examiners had 798 active dentist licenses on Jan 31, 2026 (Legislative Audit), with only 2 prosthodontist, 7 periodontist and 23 oral-surgeon specialty licenses; ADA HPI's 2025 workforce report puts Alaska at 78.4 dentists per 100,000 in 2024 vs 59.5 nationally, which on the state's 738,737 population implies ~580 professionally active dentists (estimate). Census CBP (2023) counts 315 dental offices in Alaska. NPI-based counts put ~472 dental providers in Anchorage, 151 in Fairbanks, 100 in Wasilla. Fees: Alaska's measured average porcelain crown is $1,644 (+18% vs $1,399 US; ASQ360/CareCredit 2023-24), HPI-based private estimate $1,414 (+8%), and Alaska Medicaid pays $827 for D2740, the highest listed; Alaska ranks 4th on a restorative cost index. Local labs physically in Alaska with websites: Castable Ceramics (Anchorage, since 1986, now an Apex Dental Laboratory Group lab; FCZ, e.max, PFZ, custom Ti/Zr abutments, local pickup); Precision Dental Designs (Anchorage; Prettau zirconia, hybrid bridges, Pekkton, removables; says it also serves the lower 48 via free FedEx labels); Trinity Dental Lab (Anchorage; Jin S. Seo CDT, 30 yrs; zirconia, e.max, All-on-X, same-day repairs); Evo Dental Milling and Design (Anchorage, same address as Take 2 Dental Implant Studio; published prices: FCZ on Ti-base $399, custom Ti abutment $149, cement-retained FCZ $129, zirconia full arch $2,999-$3,499, Ti bar $999, printed full-arch temp $399). Directory-only listings (unverified): Gnathestics Dental Lab and Brown's Dental Plastics (Anchorage), Eagle Dental Lab (Eagle River, owner on LinkedIn since 2003), Wasilla Dental Lab, Valley Dental Lab and Juneau Ceramic Studio (Juneau), Peninsula Dental Laboratory (Sterling). In-house production: Take 2 Dental Implant Studio (full-arch only, zirconia/Ti milled in-house, "no outsourcing"), Woodside Dental Group (in-house technician; $22,999/arch, $45,999 full mouth all-in zirconia), Anchorage Midtown Dental (on-site lab for one-day crowns), and at least ten CEREC/same-day-crown practices across Anchorage, Mat-Su, Fairbanks and Juneau. Southcentral Foundation (tribal) runs its own prosthodontic clinic and labs and in Aug 2026 was hiring six dental lab technicians ($30.14-$40.18/hr) for three clinics; its contracted-dentist RFPs route implant and full-mouth work to SCF Prosthodontics, so tribal programs are not a near-term lab customer. DSO penetration is low (~4.8% of providers; MB2 Dental 10 providers; Pacific Dental Alliance in Fairbanks; btyDENTAL 8 Anchorage offices). National labs reach Alaska with friction: Glidewell's $9 FedEx overnight is contiguous-US only (Alaska gets free USPS Priority at 2-4 days each way); Next Dental Lab (FL) markets to Alaska with ~5 business days ground each way; VTA excludes AK/HI from its 7-day promise; Dandy is digital-only (UT/TX labs) with no Alaska-specific policy found.

Logistics: Alaska Air Cargo GoldStreak, Seattle (Zone 4) to Anchorage (Zone 2), is $74 minimum for up to 1 lb plus $2.56/lb (letter $49) effective Oct 1, 2026 (up from $69/$44 in Jan 2026), plus a $0.05/lb security fee ($12.50 min); tender 60 min before departure, pick up 60 min after arrival; SEA cargo (2600 S 165th St) and ANC cargo (4100 Old International Airport Rd) accept GoldStreak 24/7; Alaska flies ~107 SEA-ANC nonstops weekly. Known Shipper status is required only for pieces of 16 oz or more, so an Alaska dentist can tender a single-crown case to Integra without being vetted. FedEx One Rate (Alaska included): 2Day small box $19.55, Standard Overnight small box $101.75, Priority Overnight small box $148.20; FedEx Priority Overnight has no Saturday delivery to Alaska. UPS Next Day Air 2026 daily list to Alaska zone 124: 1 lb $127.35, 2 lb $139.78. Taxes/regulatory: no state sales tax; Anchorage levies none (two 3% proposals were postponed indefinitely, Mar 2025 and Jan 2026); Mat-Su Borough 0% but Palmer 3% and Wasilla levies a city tax; Juneau has a sales tax. Foreign LLC registration $350, biennial report $200, business license $50/yr. Alaska does not register dental labs or technicians; lab work is lawful on a dentist's prescription (AS 08.36.360(4)); only about a dozen states (FL, KY, TX, SC, etc.) regulate labs.

Reach: Alaska Dental Society (1407 W 31st Ave, Anchorage, 907-563-3003) held its 2026 annual meeting May 22-23 in Seward (implant-focused CE) and will hold 2027's on Feb 18-19 at Waikoloa, Hawaii, with a vendor marketplace whose sponsorships "sell out" (commitments due Dec 2026). Components: Anchorage DS (irregular), Mat-Su DS (irregular), North Central DS in Fairbanks (2nd Tuesday monthly), Southeast DS (1st Wednesday), Juneau (irregular). No Alaska Seattle Study Club affiliate or implant study club was found.

ESTIMATES. Lab density: ~8-12 identifiable commercial labs for 580-800 dentists (1 per 50-100) vs Washington's ~175 lab establishments for ~5,000 dentists (1 per ~29). Obtainable demand: 5-10 accounts and 30-80 units/month within 12-18 months is a judgment, not a measured figure. Switching barriers are real: 30-40-year local lab relationships with pickup, high CEREC penetration, in-house full-arch at the two most aggressive implant practices, weather-exposed air logistics, and a dentist population one-ninth of Washington's. What favors Integra: same-day air transit that beats Anchorage labs for Fairbanks/Juneau on time, wholesale pricing well under Evo's published retail (e.g., $22 mill-only vs $129-$399 FCZ; $650 vs $2,999 zirconia arch) for the small Anchorage labs, the owner's existing Known Shipper status, and Seattle being the natural CE and travel hub.

UNKNOWNS. No Census count of Alaska lab establishments (API key required); no FedEx standard-list "To Alaska" table retrieved; no public statement found of an Alaska dentist naming a Seattle lab; ADS exhibitor fees; actual negotiated courier discounts; Alaska dentists' current turnaround expectations (only inferences from CEREC adoption and national-lab transit claims).

findings.claim: Alaska had 798 active dentist licenses as of January 31, 2026; specialty licenses included 23 oral & maxillofacial surgery, 7 periodontics, 14 endodontics, 2 prosthodontics; 3,179 total dental licenses/certificates/permits.
findings.detail: Alaska Division of Legislative Audit sunset review of the Board of Dental Examiners, Exhibit 2 ('License, Certificate, Endorsement, and Permit Activity FY23 through January 31, 2026'). Earlier counts: 815 (FY20), 820 (Jan 31, 2018), 898 total dentist licenses in an earlier DCBPL statistics table. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: ADA HPI puts Alaska at about 78.4 dentists per 100,000 population in 2024 (US 59.5), among the highest state ratios; Alaska's ratio fell 1.8% from 2014 to 2024.
findings.detail: Read from the state map in 'U.S. Dentist Workforce - 2025 update' (ADA HPI, data as of Aug 2025); the map label order and the -1.8% change applied to the 2014 ratio of 79.78 (CDC/NCHS table) both give ~78.4. Prior HPI/CDC figures: 80.8 (2015), 80.51 (2019, 589 dentists), 80.25 (2021). Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Implied professionally active dentists in Alaska in 2024-25: roughly 580.
findings.detail: Estimate: 78.4 per 100K x 738,737 (Alaska DOLWD July 1, 2025 estimate) = ~579. Licensure (798) exceeds this because it includes out-of-state and non-practicing licensees. ADA HPI 2019 masterfile count was 589.

findings.claim: Alaska population July 1, 2025: 738,737 statewide; Anchorage 289,221; Mat-Su Borough 117,412; Fairbanks North Star Borough 97,083; Juneau 31,182.
findings.detail: Alaska Department of Labor and Workforce Development population estimates; the four target areas total ~535,000 (72% of the state). Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Alaska has 315 dental office establishments (NAICS 621210) employing 2,417 (Census County Business Patterns 2023).
findings.detail: Secondary compilation (PlainBizBench) of CBP 2023 for Alaska. Next Dental Lab's Alaska marketing page independently cites 'roughly 350 practices statewide'. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: NPI-registered dental providers by Alaska metro: Anchorage 472, Fairbanks 151, Wasilla 100; 1,285 statewide (includes hygienists); DSO-affiliated share ~4.8% (62 providers).
findings.detail: ProviderSignal territory page; top 'DSO' entries are actually tribal health corporations (SEARHC 20+14 providers), then MB2 Dental (10) and Mint Dental (3). Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Alaska dental fees are among the highest in the US: measured average porcelain crown $1,644 (+18% vs $1,399 national), 46th of 51 markets; restorative cost index 130 (4th highest) with implant $5,450 and denture $2,371.
findings.detail: ASQ360 Market Research / CareCredit Average Procedural Cost Study (2023-2024) as republished by Real Dental Costs. Alternate estimates: HPI-2024-based private crown estimate $1,414 (+8%, PlainDentalCost); Pearl $1,824. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Alaska Medicaid's fee-for-service rate for D2740 (porcelain/ceramic crown) is $827, the highest state Medicaid crown fee in the compiled list; Medicaid paid an average $386 per claim line.
findings.detail: Real Dental Costs D2740 table citing state Medicaid fee schedules and HHS T-MSIS 2023-2024. Indicates even public-payer crown reimbursement in Alaska is well above the lab fee. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Castable Ceramics (Anchorage) is a full-service lab operating since 1986 and is now part of the Apex Dental Laboratory Group (21 labs, Waco TX); it offers full-contour zirconia, e.max, PFZ, PFM, cast metal, custom titanium/zirconia abutments, removables and local pickup.
findings.detail: Apex site: 'Anchorage's finest provider of restorative solutions for more than 30 years'; 'Every case ... restored by our technicians right here in Alaska'; Apex says restorations are fabricated in-house at network labs. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Precision Dental Designs (1569 Bragaw St Ste 200, Anchorage) is a full-service lab using Prettau zirconia ('Alaska Strong FCZ'), zirconia hybrid bridges, Pekkton frameworks, genuine Nobel/3i/Straumann abutments, e.max, Empress, removables; it states it also serves dentists in the contiguous 48 and offers free FedEx shipping labels.
findings.detail: Company site product pages. Phone (907) 274-1648. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Trinity Dental Lab (4111 Minnesota Dr, Anchorage) is a full-service digital lab owned by Jin S. Seo, CDT (30 years), offering zirconia, e.max, PFM, full cast, custom abutments, screw/cement-retained implant crowns, All-on-X, dentures, and same/next-day repairs ('call before 10 am ... ready by 4:30 pm').
findings.detail: Company site, About and Products pages. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Evo Dental Milling and Design (502 W Northern Lights Blvd, Anchorage; same address as Take 2 Dental Implant Studio) publishes prices: full-contour zirconia on Ti-base $399; custom Ti abutment $149; cement-retained FCZ crown on custom abutment $129; layered porcelain add-on $99; zirconia full arch $2,999 (no gingiva) / $3,499 (with Miyo pink); Ti bar substructure $999; Ti-base sleeve $59/unit; printed full-arch temp $399; full-arch design only $199; printed occlusal guard $99-$199.
findings.detail: The only published Alaska lab price list found; it is the local retail benchmark against Integra's lab-to-lab $22 mill-only crown, $650 full-arch zirconia and $299-$399 Ti bar. Site says 'small laboratory in Midtown Anchorage ... now accepting new clients ... training by our Doctor'. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Additional Alaska labs appear only in directories (unverified status): Gnathestics Dental Lab (8301 Briarwood St #204, Anchorage, 907-344-2336); Eagle Dental Lab (12212 Old Glenn Hwy #206, Eagle River, 907-694-5222; owner listed on LinkedIn since Apr 2003); Brown's Dental Plastics (Anchorage) and S Brown Dental Plastics (Eagle River); Wasilla Dental Lab (351 W Swanson Ave #1, Wasilla, same address as Wasilla Dental Center); Valley Dental Lab (2525 Industrial Blvd #200B, Juneau) and Juneau Ceramic Studio (9554 Glacier Hwy, Juneau); Peninsula Dental Laboratory (Sterling); Alaska Dental Laboratory LLC (registered Nov 2018, Anchorage).
findings.detail: localbusinessfinder411 Alaska dental-laboratory directory, Exa Places, uszm.com, LinkedIn, Alaska company directory. No websites found; several may be in-office labs or defunct. No commercial crown-and-bridge lab with a website was found in Fairbanks, Juneau or Mat-Su. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Take 2 Dental Implant Studio (Dr. Guy Burk, DMD, DABOI; 502 W Northern Lights Blvd Ste A, Anchorage) is 'Alaska's first and only practice limited to full-mouth immediate-load' full-arch implants, uses Straumann BLX, and fabricates zirconia and titanium restorations in an in-house lab ('No outsourcing').
findings.detail: Practice site; claims one of only two board-certified implantologists in Alaska; 3-year restoration guarantee. Not a lab customer; possible equipment/CAM/overflow-milling prospect. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Woodside Dental Group (Dr. Green, GP; 2900 Boniface Pkwy Ste 100, Anchorage) publishes All-on-4 pricing of $22,999 per arch and $45,999 full mouth, all-inclusive with zirconia final bridge, produced with an in-house dental lab technician.
findings.detail: Practice site; final zirconia bridges fabricated over 5-6 weeks after 4 months of healing. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Same-day CEREC/in-office milling is widespread: Midnight Sun Dental (Anchorage/Eagle River/Wasilla), Anchorage Midtown Dental (on-site lab), Palmer Dental Center, Evergreen Dental (Palmer), Same Day Dental (Wasilla), Neibaur Dental, Otter Dental, Advanced Family Dentistry of Fairbanks, Nanook Dental, Fairbanks Dental Center, Fairbanks Dental Associates, and Dr. Mark Riederer (Juneau) all market same-day crowns.
findings.detail: Compiled from practice websites (see targets). Fairbanks in particular shows 6 CEREC practices among ~150 dental providers, which caps single-unit demand there. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Southcentral Foundation (Alaska Native health, Anchorage/Mat-Su) runs an in-house prosthodontic clinic with a dental lab (opened 2020) and in August 2026 was hiring six Dental Laboratory Technicians at $30.14-$40.18/hr (2 Family Dental, 2 Fireweed Dental, 2 Valley Native Primary Care Center); its contracted dental services RFPs (2023, 2024) exclude implant services (D6000-D6199) and fixed prosthesis and route full-mouth rehabilitation to SCF Prosthodontics.
findings.detail: SCF news release (Nov 2020); job postings via Career.com/iHireDental/ResuMinder (posted Jun-Aug 2026); RFP SCF23-1108 and SCF24-1145 scope-of-work exclusions. ANTHC procurement runs through the Bonfire portal (RFP 27-R-253330 example, Sept 2026). Implication: tribal programs are mostly self-supplied; outside lab purchases would be via formal solicitation, not sales calls. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: DSO presence is limited: MB2 Dental (10 providers) and Mint Dental (3) are the only conventional DSOs listed; Pacific Dental Alliance operates Affordable Dental Care in Fairbanks; Alaska-owned groups include btyDENTAL (8 Anchorage offices), Alaska Premier Dental Group (Anchorage + Wasilla), Midnight Sun/Alaska Dental Group (3 offices), Four Corners Dental Group (Anchorage + Fairbanks). No Aspen Dental, PDS or Heartland Alaska offices were found.
findings.detail: ProviderSignal DSO table; btydental.com locations page; smilealaska.com; Exa Places (Pacific Dental Alliance, 503 14th Ave, Fairbanks). No in-house DSO lab in Alaska was identified. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Glidewell's $9-each-way FedEx Overnight case shipping is 'contiguous U.S. only'; Alaska practices get prepaid USPS Priority Mail labels at no cost with 2-4 business days each way; Glidewell warns 'overnight delivery may not be available in certain rural areas'.
findings.value: USPS 2-4 days each way to/from Alaska
findings.detail: glidewelldental.com pickup-and-delivery page and price list PDF. Alaska is in the shipping-supplies state dropdown, so Glidewell does serve Alaska, just slower. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Other national labs target Alaska with longer transit: Next Dental Lab (Deerfield Beach, FL) markets 'about 5 business days of ground transit each way' and 'around 72% lower fees than typical Alaska labs'; Keating Dental Lab (Irvine, CA) has an Alaska landing page; VTA Dental Lab excludes Hawaii and Alaska from its 7-business-day promise; Dandy (digital-only, labs in Lehi UT and Carrollton TX) publishes no Alaska-specific policy.
findings.detail: Vendor pages. Note Next Dental Lab's claim about Alaska lab fees is marketing, not a measured figure. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: No Pacific Northwest lab (Nakanishi, Assured, Pacific Dental Arts, Ziemek, PNW Pros, TC Dental) publicly states it serves Alaska, and no Alaska dentist website found names a Seattle/Washington lab.
findings.detail: Two targeted searches returned only generic PNW lab pages (Pacific Dental Arts and Ziemek in Olympia, PNW Pros in Bellevue, TC Dental in Portland) without Alaska references. Absence of evidence, not evidence of absence.

findings.claim: Alaska Air Cargo GoldStreak (next-flight, no prebooking) from Seattle (Zone 4) to Anchorage (Zone 2): $74 minimum charge covering the first pound, $2.56/lb thereafter ($2.34/lb at 30 lb); GoldStreak Letter (<1 lb in Alaska letter packaging) $49. Anchorage to Seattle: $72 minimum, letter $47. Seattle to Juneau (Zone 3): $74 minimum, letter $49. Rates effective October 1, 2026.
findings.detail: GoldStreak Shipping Rates Oct 2026 PDF read with the 2025 Cargo Zone Map (Zone 2 = Anchorage and Fairbanks only; Zone 4 = Seattle and Portland only; Zone 3 = Southeast Alaska incl. Juneau). The Jan 10, 2026 chart showed $69 minimum / $44 letter for the same lane, so Oct 2026 is a ~7% increase. Dimensional weight may apply. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: GoldStreak operating rules: tender at the cargo facility 60 minutes before departure; available for pickup 60 minutes after arrival; guarantee (up to 50% refund) only if booked in advance; domestic security screening fee $0.05/lb with $12.50 minimum (CCSF shippers exempt); dangerous-goods fee $95.
findings.value: 60 min before / 60 min after; $12.50 min screening
findings.detail: alaskacargo.com GoldStreak page, Rates page (Surcharges and Fees) and GoldStreak Rules and Regulations for Carriage. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Cargo facilities: Seattle/Tacoma 2600 S 165th St, Seattle WA 98158 (GoldStreak drop-off 24/7; freight Mon-Fri 4:30am-10pm, Sat 9am-10pm, Sun 1pm-10pm); Anchorage 4100 Old International Airport Rd, Anchorage AK 99502 (GoldStreak 24/7; air freight Mon-Fri 5am-10pm, Sat 9am-5pm, Sun closed). Phone 1-800-225-2752.
findings.value: GoldStreak 24/7 at both SEA and ANC
findings.detail: alaskacargo.com network-locations pages for SeaTac and Anchorage. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: TSA Known Shipper status is NOT required for Alaska Air Cargo shipments under 16 oz total weight, intra-Alaska shipments, or shipments moved entirely on freighters; business Known Shippers get a CID, no annual renewal, and may apply for a credit (invoiced) account.
findings.detail: alaskacargo.com Known Shipper pages. Practical effect: a single-crown case box (typically a few ounces) can be tendered by any Alaska dentist to Integra without vetting; Integra's existing Known Shipper status covers heavier return shipments (models, full-arch cases). Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Alaska Airlines operates about 107 SEA-ANC nonstops per week (~3h45m); recent one-way Saver fares $240-$306 and typical round-trip $280-$620 (Google Flights), with January cheapest and July most expensive.
findings.detail: Google Flights route page (107 nonstop + 975 connecting Alaska flights/week; cheapest RT $387), Alaska Airlines route page (Saver one-way from $240-$306, Oct 2026-Feb 2027), Kayak (typical $336-$477 RT). Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: FedEx One Rate flat pricing applies to Alaska at the National zone: FedEx Envelope Priority Overnight $81.95 / Standard Overnight $55.60; Pak $132.40 / $91.30; Small Box $148.20 / $101.75; Medium Box $167.65 / $105.80; 2Day Small Box $19.55 and Pak $16.30 (2Day flat nationwide); Express Saver is not available for Alaska. Effective April 20, 2026.
findings.detail: FedEx One Rate pricing PDF (mirror on shipscience.com; fedex.com blocks crawlers). FedEx's 2026 standard list rates to Alaska (zones on pp. 22-27 of the list-rate PDF) could not be extracted. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: FedEx Priority Overnight Saturday delivery is not offered to Alaska or Hawaii; Alaska deliveries follow Monday-Friday schedules.
findings.detail: ParcelPath explainer (Feb 2026) consistent with FedEx service terms. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: UPS 2026 Daily Rates, UPS Next Day Air to Alaska zone 124 (Alaska metro, which includes Anchorage): Letter $83.24, 1 lb $127.35, 2 lb $139.78, 5 lb $184.60; zone 126 (Alaska/Hawaii extended) 1 lb $127.45, 2 lb $139.92.
findings.detail: UPS '2026 UPS Rates - Daily' PDF, UPS Next Day Air table columns 102-108, 124, 125, 126. Zone assignment for 98007->99503 should be confirmed with the UPS zone chart; list rates before any account discount. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: The State of Alaska levies no sales tax; the Municipality of Anchorage levies no general sales tax (0%), nor does the Matanuska-Susitna Borough; Palmer levies 3%, North Pole 5.5%; Juneau and Wasilla levy city sales taxes.
findings.detail: Alaska Office of the State Assessor sales-tax page and 2024 Alaska Taxable report (rows for Anchorage, Mat-Su Borough, Palmer, North Pole). Juneau (5%) and Wasilla (city tax) are confirmed as sales-tax communities by ADN (Jan 2026); exact Wasilla/Juneau/Fairbanks rows were not extracted from the report. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Anchorage's proposed 3% sales tax has twice been postponed indefinitely: AO 2024-105(SA) 'Project Anchorage' on March 18, 2025 (8-4) and Mayor LaFrance's AO 2025-133 on January 13, 2026 (12-0); no sales tax is scheduled.
findings.value: No Anchorage sales tax through at least 2028
findings.detail: Municipality of Anchorage Assembly pages; ADN coverage. Even if a future measure passed, levy would start no earlier than July 2028. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Alaska foreign (non-Alaskan) LLC registration costs $350 (form 08-497); biennial report $200 ($247.50 if late), due January 2 every other year; Alaska business license $50 per year; a foreign entity may not transact business in Alaska until registered.
findings.detail: Alaska Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing fee pages and Biennial Report FAQs; AS 10.50.720 lists activities not constituting 'conducting affairs' (soliciting orders that require acceptance outside the state may be exempt from registration but not from business licensing if 'engaging in business' in Alaska). Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Alaska does not license or register dental laboratories or dental technicians; the Board of Dental Examiners licenses dentists, hygienists and dental-assistant certificates only, and AS 08.36.360(4) makes constructing dentures/bridges/appliances lawful when done on prescription of a licensed dentist using the dentist's impressions or casts.
findings.detail: Board of Dental Examiners application list (no lab category); AS 08.36.360; dentallabs.org notes only ~12 states regulate labs/technicians (e.g., Florida ch. 466/64B27, Kentucky 201 KAR 8:016 which asserts jurisdiction over out-of-state labs serving KY dentists, Texas Occ. Code ch. 266, South Carolina). Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Dental laboratory technician wages in Alaska: ~30 employed, median $28.44/hr ($59,150/yr), mean $63,640 (BLS OEWS May 2024, via WageDepth); BLS May 2021 primary: Alaska 50 employed, mean $26.99/hr ($56,140), Anchorage 30 employed, mean $25.86/hr ($53,780) vs Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue 490 employed, $26.16/hr.
findings.detail: BLS OEWS May 2021 occupation page (primary) and WageDepth's reproduction of May 2024 state data; bls.gov 2024 occupation page redirected to an index during fetch. Current market signal: SCF hiring range $30.14-$40.18/hr (Aug 2026). Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Lab density comparison: Alaska has roughly 8-12 identifiable commercial dental labs for 580-800 dentists (about 1 lab per 50-100 dentists); Washington has ~175 dental-lab establishments for ~5,000 dentists (about 1 per 29).
findings.detail: Estimate. Alaska lab count from company sites plus directory listings (this research); Washington establishment count 175 (CBP/QCEW via Fair Market Value, 2025); Washington dentist count ~5,000 from HPI ratio (~64/100K) x ~7.95M population. Alaska is thinner but Anchorage has at least four full-service labs including full-arch zirconia capability, so 'underserved' is not demonstrated; the gap is outside Anchorage and in independent digital milling.

findings.claim: Alaska Dental Society (1407 W 31st Ave, Anchorage; 907-563-3003) held its 2026 Annual Meeting May 22-23 in Seward with a two-day implant 'mini-residency' course (Dr. Andrew Currie) and ADA President Dr. Richard Rosato attending; the 2027 Annual Meeting & Vendor Marketplace is February 18-19, 2027 at the Waikoloa Beach Marriott, Big Island, Hawaii; ADS says sponsorships 'will sell out' with signed agreements due in December 2026.
findings.detail: akdental.org annual-meeting, sponsorship and 2026 program PDF; ADS positions itself as 'fostering collaboration between dentists, labs, and technology partners'. The off-state venue means exhibiting reaches Alaska dentists but at Hawaii travel cost. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: ADS component societies and meeting cadence: Anchorage Dental Society (irregular; anchds.org), Mat-Su Dental Society (irregular; matsuds.org), North Central Dental Society in Fairbanks (2nd Tuesday monthly; northcentralds.org), Southeast Dental Society (1st Wednesday monthly, noon; Craig/Ketchikan/Petersburg/Sitka/Wrangell), Juneau (irregular), Kenai-Kodiak (yearly in February), Coastal (none); no meetings June-August.
findings.detail: akdental.org component-meetings page and component sites. No Alaska Seattle Study Club affiliate, Spear club or implant study club was found in searches. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Alaska's two licensed prosthodontists appear to include Dr. Bridget DeYoung (Healthy Smiles Forever, mobile/long-term-care digital dentures; formerly SEARHC and SCF) and Dr. Mark Williams (listed at Alaska Pioneer Homes, Anchorage); other 'prosthodontics' listings are military (JBER) or GP practices marketing prosthodontic services (Anchorage Midtown Dental).
findings.detail: Audit specialty count (2 prosthodontic licenses); US News and Healthgrades listings; healthysmilesforever.org provider page. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Oral-surgery/periodontal implant placement in Alaska is concentrated in a few practices: Anchorage Oral & Implant Surgery (Drs. Reinbold and Parameswaran, 2000 Abbott Rd Ste 200), Alaska Center for Oral + Facial Surgery (Dr. Nordstrom; All-on-4; AAAHC-accredited), All Alaska Oral & Craniofacial Surgery (Dr. Dashow, 4200 Lake Otis Pkwy), Alaska Oral Surgery Group (Dr. Szutz, Eagle River), Alaska Periodontics & Implant Surgery (2020 Abbott Rd), Meridian Park Oral Surgery (Wasilla; Drs. Monaco, Chavarria, Ebadpour), Summit Oral Surgery (Wasilla; Dr. Wimsatt), Fairbanks Periodontal Associates (All-on-4), and Dr. Charles Schultz OMS (Juneau; CBCT).
findings.detail: Practice websites. These surgeons explicitly state the restorative dentist 'fits and makes the permanent prosthesis', i.e., the restoring GP chooses the lab. Accessed 2026-10-12.

findings.claim: Turnaround expectations in Alaska are not documented publicly; inference: with national labs quoting 2-5 business days of transit each way to Alaska and 12+ CEREC practices, Alaska GPs currently either mill in-office, use local Anchorage labs with pickup, or accept roughly two-week national-lab cycles. GoldStreak same-day plus a 2-day Integra cycle could deliver 3-4 business days door-to-door, faster than national labs and competitive with Anchorage labs for Fairbanks/Juneau offices.
findings.detail: Estimate built from Glidewell (USPS 2-4 days each way to AK), Next Dental Lab (5 business days ground each way), and GoldStreak schedules; Alaska Airlines ~15 SEA-ANC nonstops/day. No Alaska dentist survey on turnaround was found.

findings.claim: Obtainable demand for Integra in Alaska within 12-18 months: roughly 5-10 accounts and 30-80 units/month, mostly lab-to-lab milling and implant/full-arch work for GPs outside the two in-house full-arch practices.
findings.detail: Judgment, not a measured figure: ~580 active dentists, ~half in Anchorage with 4+ local full-service labs and pickup; high CEREC penetration in Fairbanks/Mat-Su; in-house labs at Take 2, Woodside, Anchorage Midtown and SCF; tribal volume closed to sales calls. Upside case depends on winning 2-3 small Anchorage labs as milling customers (Evo's published $129-$399 FCZ and $2,999 arch leave wholesale room for Integra's $22 mill-only and $650 arch).

unknowns: Census County Business Patterns count of NAICS 339116 dental-laboratory establishments for Alaska, the Municipality of Anchorage and King County WA (api.census.gov requires a key; data.census.gov is not crawlable); the Alaska vs Washington lab-density comparison is therefore built from company sites, directories and a secondary WA figure.
ADA HPI's exact 2024 count of professionally active dentists in Alaska (held in the Supply of Dentists XLSX, not parsed); ~580 is derived from the 78.4 per-100K map label.

FedEx 2026 Standard List Rates for Priority/Standard Overnight to Alaska (the 'To Alaska' zone table on pp. 22-27 of the list-rate PDF) and the FedEx zone for 98007 to 99503; only FedEx One Rate flat prices were obtained.
UPS zone assignment for Bellevue 98007 to Anchorage 99503 (assumed zone 124 'Alaska metro'); negotiated carrier discounts for a small lab are unknown.
Whether any Alaska dentist currently uses a Seattle/Bellevue laboratory; no public statement was found either way.

Operating status, size and services of directory-only labs (Gnathestics, Eagle Dental Lab, Brown's Dental Plastics, Wasilla Dental Lab, Valley Dental Lab Juneau, Juneau Ceramic Studio, Peninsula Dental Laboratory, Alaska Dental Laboratory LLC) and the staff size of Castable Ceramics, Precision Dental Designs and Trinity.
Price lists of Castable Ceramics, Precision Dental Designs and Trinity (none published); Evo is the only Alaska lab with public prices.
ADS 2027 Annual Meeting vendor/sponsor fee schedule (not published on the open page) and whether lab vendors attended the 2026 Seward meeting.
Alaska dentists' turnaround expectations and current shipping habits (no survey or published quotes found); inferences only.
Dandy's and NDX/DDS Lab's shipping and turnaround policies specifically for Alaska practices.
Exact 2024 Alaska Taxable sales-tax rows for Wasilla, Juneau and the City of Fairbanks (Juneau and Wasilla confirmed as sales-tax cities by ADN; rates commonly cited as 5% and 2.5%).
Alaska registered-agent cost for a foreign LLC (no vendor quote requested); market range used.
Whether Alaska Air Cargo screening fees apply to GoldStreak letters under 1 lb and whether Integra's Known Shipper record requires a credit account for invoicing.

competitors.name: Castable Ceramics (Apex Dental Laboratory Group)
competitors.what: Full-service lab since 1986: full-contour zirconia, e.max, PFZ, PFM, cast metal, custom Ti/Zr abutments, removables; local pickup and shipping labels; member of 21-lab Apex network (Waco, TX).
competitors.notes: Longest-established Anchorage lab; network backing means it is unlikely to outsource milling to Integra.

competitors.name: Precision Dental Designs
competitors.what: Full-service ceramic, metal, removable and implant lab; Prettau zirconia 'Alaska Strong FCZ', zirconia hybrid bridges, Pekkton frameworks, genuine Nobel/3i/Straumann abutments, surgical guides.
competitors.notes: States it also serves dentists in the contiguous 48 via free FedEx labels; most direct full-arch competitor in Alaska.

competitors.name: Trinity Dental Lab
competitors.what: Full-service digital lab (owner Jin S. Seo, CDT, 30 yrs): zirconia, e.max, PFM, full cast, custom abutments, screw/cement-retained implant crowns, All-on-X, dentures, repairs/relines, shade matching.
competitors.turnaround: Same/next-day repairs: call before 10 am, ready by 4:30 pm
competitors.notes: Small owner-operated lab; plausible lab-to-lab milling customer for Bear Milling (zirconia, Ti bars) rather than a pure competitor.

competitors.name: Evo Dental Milling and Design
competitors.location: 502 W Northern Lights Blvd, Anchorage, AK 99503 (same address as Take 2 Dental Implant Studio)
competitors.what: Small lab specializing in full-arch and single-unit implant restorations; also trains doctors to go digital.
competitors.pricing: FCZ on Ti-base $399; custom Ti abutment $149; cement-retained FCZ $129; layered porcelain +$99; zirconia full arch $2,999 / $3,499 with pink; Ti bar $999; Ti-base sleeve $59; printed FA temp $399; FA design only $199; guards $99-$199
competitors.notes: Only Alaska lab with public prices; sets the local retail benchmark Integra's lab-to-lab menu undercuts by 3-5x on milling.

competitors.name: Southcentral Foundation dental labs (Fireweed Dental, Family Dental, Valley Native Primary Care Center)

competitors.name: Chairside CEREC/same-day practices (Midnight Sun Dental, Anchorage Midtown Dental, Palmer Dental Center, Evergreen Dental, Same Day Dental, Neibaur, Otter, Advanced Family Dentistry of Fairbanks, Nanook, Fairbanks Dental Center, Fairbanks Dental Associates, Dr. Riederer Juneau)
competitors.what: In-office milling of single-unit crowns; several also restore implants chairside.
competitors.notes: Caps single-unit demand, especially in Fairbanks; these offices still outsource bridges, implant bars and removables.

competitors.name: Glidewell Dental
competitors.what: National lab; serves Alaska with prepaid USPS Priority Mail labels (2-4 business days each way); $9 FedEx overnight is contiguous-US only.
competitors.pricing: Zirconia monolithic ~$89-$109 per Dandy's comparison (plus $9-$15 shipping)
competitors.turnaround: Not Alaska-specific; USPS adds 2-4 days each way
competitors.notes: Price anchor Alaska GPs know; slower to Alaska than to the lower 48.

competitors.name: Dandy
competitors.location: Lehi/Provo, UT and Carrollton, TX (national, digital-only)
competitors.what: Scanner-bundled digital lab; 5-business-day zirconia crowns; free shipping; no physical impressions.
competitors.pricing: All-in pricing comparable to Glidewell per its own comparison; minimum monthly spend
competitors.turnaround: 5 business days for zirconia crowns (lower-48 basis); Alaska policy not stated
competitors.notes: Competes for the same digital-only GP segment Integra would target in Fairbanks/Juneau/Mat-Su.

competitors.name: Next Dental Lab
competitors.what: National lab actively marketing to Alaska practices ('roughly 350 practices statewide'); crown & bridge, implants, removables, full-arch.
competitors.turnaround: 3-5 business days in lab plus ~5 business days ground transit each way
competitors.notes: Shows national labs see Alaska as open territory; its transit disadvantage is Integra's opening.

competitors.name: Keating Dental Lab / VTA Dental Lab
competitors.what: National labs with Alaska landing pages or Alaska exclusions (VTA excludes AK/HI from its 7-day turnaround).
competitors.turnaround: Keating: not stated; VTA: 7 business days except AK/HI
competitors.notes: Further evidence that lower-48 labs treat Alaska as a slower, special-handling market.

competitors.name: Pacific Northwest labs (Pacific Dental Arts and Ziemek, Olympia; PNW Pros, Bellevue; TC Dental Lab, Portland)
competitors.what: Full-service PNW labs with prepaid out-of-town labels; none states Alaska service.
competitors.notes: Potential competitors for the same Alaska pitch; no evidence any currently serves Alaska.

cost_items.item: FedEx One Rate Priority Overnight, Small Box, contiguous US to Alaska (National zone)
cost_items.basis: FedEx One Rate pricing effective Apr 20, 2026: Small Box Priority Overnight $148.20; Standard Overnight $101.75 (low); Pak PO $132.40 / SO $91.30; Envelope PO $81.95. No account discounts apply to One Rate.

cost_items.item: Alaska foreign LLC registration (Certificate of Registration, form 08-497)
cost_items.basis: Alaska Division of Corporations fee schedule; required before 'transacting business' in Alaska (AS 10.50.720 lists exempt activities such as soliciting orders accepted outside the state).
$200 every two years ($100/yr equivalent), due Jan 2 of the filing year; $247.50 if filed after Feb 1.
$50 per year (new or renewal); endorsements, if any, $100 each.

cost_items.item: Alaska registered agent (required for foreign LLC)
cost_items.basis: Estimate from typical commercial registered-agent pricing; no Alaska vendor quote requested (desk research only).

cost_items.item: Owner sales trip Seattle-Anchorage round-trip airfare
cost_items.basis: Google Flights typical SEA-ANC round-trip range $280-$620 (Oct 2026); Alaska Saver one-way from $240-$306; ~107 Alaska nonstops weekly. Excludes lodging/car.

cost_items.basis: Fee schedule not published on open page; estimate from typical state-society tabletop/sponsor tiers. ADS says packages sell out; agreements due December 2026. Add Hawaii travel.
